name: isputnik-games
description: Add-on for isputnik.home: family board and arcade games in a container of their own. Requires the isputnik.home container; installed beside it and reached through home's /games gateway.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n engine,server,web "npm run dev --workspace packages/engine" "cross-env PORT=4200 npm run dev --workspace apps/server" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/engine && npm run build --workspace apps/server && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace packages/engine && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/server && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace packages/engine && npm run test --workspace apps/server && npm run test --workspace apps/web
